data.source: Deterministic synthetic smoke-test fixture; not market data

preprocessing.sequence_scaler: MinMaxScaler fit on training feature rows per fold
preprocessing.walk_forward_validation: LSTM early stopping; tabular fold models fit training rows only
preprocessing.final_holdout_refit: Random Forest uses all pre-holdout development rows with fixed parameters

limitations: Historical point-in-time news sentiment is unavailable; neutral sentiment is used in every hybrid row.
The LSTM scaler is fit on training feature rows only; validation is used only for early stopping.
The final chronological holdout is evaluated once and is not used to choose models, thresholds or weights.
Trading metrics are simplified long-or-cash close-to-close simulations with proportional costs.
